lines: They hold a baton and raise their hands.
Musicians learn if the music is fast or slow.
They learn if it is quiet or loud.
body.text: Conductors study the sheet music. They teach the musicians. They hold a baton and raise their hands. They move their hands slowly. They move their hands quickly. Musicians learn if the music is fast or slow. They learn if it is quiet or loud. They get ready to play. They play slowly. They play faster.
